title: Per-key & Per-route Usage Playbook (wireframes + backlog)
content:
Goal: design a compact, actionable Per-API-Key and Per-Route Insights view that helps engineers and platform admins quickly diagnose cost/latency hotspots, quota exhaustion risks, and anomalous usage spikes. This doc is a working playbook: wireframe sketches, interaction notes, acceptance criteria and a prioritized backlog for the next two sprints.

Audience and pain:
- Platform admins: need to understand which keys are expensive, which routes drive latency, and where to apply throttles or rerouting.
- Dev teams: need simple explanations for billing splits and per-endpoint behavior (timeouts, retries).
- SRE: needs alerts + quick to root-cause.

High-level UX principles:
1) Scannable at 1 glance: summary tiles for top-3 keys by cost, top-3 routes by tail latency, current quota headroom.
2) Fast pivots: click a key -> route breakdown -> timeline -> raw requests. Minimize clicks.
3) Actionable controls inline: adjust per-key quota, set per-route throttles, mute alerts.
4) Explanations: every metric has a tooltip with calculation, sample queries, and linked PRs.

Wireframe writeup (low-fi):
- Header: Key selector (search + grouped by org/team), timeframe dropdown, compare toggle (prev period).
- Top row: 4 tiles: Total tokens, Cost (USD), 99p latency, Quota usage %. Each tile has sparkline + delta.
- Main pane (left): Stacked bar timeline: tokens by route (color-coded). Hover shows absolute counts, route name, sample request path.
- Right pane: Route table for selected key: columns = route, calls, p95, p99, avg tokens, cost, quota impact, anomalies flagged. Rows expandable to show sample payloads and last 5 request ids.
- Bottom pane: Alerts & suggested actions: autop-run recommendations (e.g., enable prefix caching for /chat/stream, suggest 4-bit quantized model for embedding route).

Quick ASCII sketch:
[Key selector] [Timeframe] [Compare]
[TILES: tokens | cost | p99 | quota%]
[Timeline stacked by route | Route table with expandable rows]
[Alerts & Suggestions]

Interaction notes and microcopy suggestions:
- Key selector placeholder: "Search API key, team, or owner (ctrl+K)"
- Route names: prefer canonical route strings (e.g., POST /v1/chat/completions) with short alias column.
- When quota < 10%: show orange pill "Low headroom" and a recommended CI-friendly escalation path.
- Anomaly badge: small red dot + tooltip: "Spike detected vs. baseline (24w MA)". Clicking opens quick diff of payloads.

Metrics definitions (for tooltips and docs):
- Cost (USD): sum(chargeable_tokens * model_unit_price) over timeframe. Show assumptions link.
- p99 latency: end-to-end server response time at 99th percentile, excludes streaming setup time.
- Quota usage %: (consumed / allotted) * 100, per billing cycle.

Edge cases & UX decisions:
- Aggregation performance: allow sampled timeline for >1M requests; default to full fidelity for 24h.
- Keys with thousands of routes: collapse into "other" by default with a "show all" link.
- Private deployments: mask cost tile; show CPU/GPU units consumed instead.
- Multi-tenant keys: add tenant breakdown button that opens a tenant-level filter.

Backlog (prioritized):
- [P0] Per-key route table backend endpoint (fast summary metrics): JIRA-PLATFORM-987. Acceptance: returns top 50 routes with p99/p95/calls/cost in <150ms for 30d window.
- [P0] Wireframe component: tiles + stacked timeline (react components, i18n) - UX acceptance: matches sketch and passes keyboard nav.
- [P1] Alerts & recommended actions engine prototype (heuristics + link to Optimize suggestions).
- [P1] Inline quota adjuster: small modal to change per-key quotas with audit log.
- [P2] Sample payload viewer with privacy redaction toggle (PII safe).
- [P3] Compare mode: side-by-side timeline for two keys.

Acceptance criteria (sample):
- Drill path test: Select key -> click route -> see table -> see sample request within 3 clicks.
- Performance: Dashboard loads with default 7-day window in <1s for orgs with <10M tokens/day.
- Accessibility: all interactive elements reachable via keyboard; contrast ratio meets AA.

Open questions (to resolve in grooming):
- How to price exposure: show estimated USD by default for hosted customers; hide for private. (security/legal confirm)
- Which baseline for anomalies: 7d vs 28d? Proposed: use 28d rolling, but surface 7d for short windows.
- Role permissions: who can change quotas vs. who can only request? (audit flow)

Notes to reviewers: please add comments inline on the timeline interaction and the quota adjuster flow. If you have similar dashboards from other vendors that feel particularly good, paste screenshots/links in the Confluence page linked above (CONFLUENCE-1234).

- Lena: prototype tiles in Figma and share link by 2024-06-22.
- Samir: spike on sampling strategy for >100k req/min workloads (runbook doc).
